name: obsidian-link-card
description: Automatically fetches metadata from a url and makes it as a card-styled link

scripts.release: npm version patch --tag-version-prefix "" --no-git-tag-version && git add . && git commit -m "chore: release v$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")" && git tag $(node -p "require('./package.json').version") && git push && git push --tags
